title: Model Substitution Impact Simulator and Market Trigger Workbook
creator: Asha Narayanan
description: Build an actionable simulator and companion workbook that quantifies the operational and commercial impact of replacing a model (or model variant) across Redwood deployments. The tool will combine model performance profiles, cost/latency curves, regional availability, and contractual constraints to produce: 1) expected delta in latency and per-token cost, 2) estimated rollout risk (user-visible regressions, SLA failures), 3) suggested gating thresholds and procurement trigger points, and 4) a scenario-ranking output for sales/solutions to present to customers.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive workbook with ingestable model profiles and region/capacity knobs (Google Sheets prototype)
Backend prototype that runs 1,000 Monte Carlo substitution scenarios given current model usage distribution and outputs cost/latency deltas
Defined set of trigger rules (thresholds) and alert templates that map to Watchtower/Model Watchlist alerts
Stakeholder signoff from Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Legal on the procurement trigger definitions
comments: 2025-02-21 - Kickoff: aligned on scope with Solutions Eng, Sales, and Legal. Primary goal is to reduce ad-hoc vendor switch churn and give Sales defensible switching costs. Action: SE to provide 3 anonymized customer usage profiles by 2025-02-25. - Asha

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: model performance profiles are noisy across customers -> Mitigation: use aggregated histograms and provide confidence bands
Risk: legal/contract constraints block substitutions at customer-level -> Mitigation: surface 'contractual_hold' early and include manual approval step
Risk: simulation cost grows with sequence-level fidelity -> Mitigation: default to distribution sampling and gate expensive runs behind enterprise pilot
